## Clarity fixes in round 2

| What was unclear | Fix |
|---|---|
| Report date chip looked like static text | It is a button with a calendar icon and a chevron. It opens the period control. |
| Baseline / Update switch mixed two questions: which schedule am I looking at, and what am I comparing it to | Current schedule is one choice. Compare and Baseline are separate switches, each with its own marker style in a legend. |
| Three periods had no way to be read apart | Solid = current, outline = comparison, dashed = baseline, teal = user-defined. Legend strip above the board when more than one is on. |
| Display pane had a Datasets tab that repeated the period choice | Removed. Periods have one home: the report button. |
| "Remark stickers" switch was mislabelled | Renamed "Short title". It is the display label, SHORT_TITLE_MODE. |
| Health and Progress were drawn as dropdowns | Health is the 5-dot pill with who set it. Progress is the bar with a word. |
| Forecast and Variance were invented | Removed. Finish plus derived movement rows instead. |
| "Complete" and "Done" looked the same | Complete (from schedule, black) and Done (set by you, green). |
